title: Very useful
body: I love that i can set up ratings and customize this. The progress is very encouraging and helpful to actually track individual habits I wanted built. I can track which area i have the most needed self-discipline. If the app could be bought on a per month basis like netflix this would attract a bigger audience considering its pandemic. But great app
